Markets.title: US Treasury yields slip as AI concerns boost safe haven demand ahead of 20 year auction
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields fell as investor concerns over the impact of borrowing costs on AI stocks increased demand for safe-haven assets. This decline occurred ahead of a $13 billion 20-year Treasury auction and expectations that the Federal Reserve will likely keep interest rates unchanged.

Markets.title: Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
Markets.summary: Persistent Systems has launched a qualified institutional placement to raise up to $450 million, or approximately Rs 4,265 crore. The IT company set the floor price at Rs 5,550 per share and may offer investors a discount of up to 5%.

Markets.title: Stocks, gold or crypto? The last 3 years’ returns have a surprising answer
Markets.summary: Over a three-year period, Bitcoin outperformed stocks, gold, and silver with nearly 234% returns. However, precious metals performed better over the last year as cryptocurrency values declined.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Despite an Rs 8 lakh crore market selloff and extreme volatility, the Sensex and Nifty closed above their pre-closing auction session levels. Cautious market sentiment was driven by elevated crude prices, foreign investor outflows, and weak market breadth.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Wipro among 5 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Technical analysts have recommended Wipro, NHPC, Sagility, LTTS, and Hexaware Technologies for potential gains on Thursday. These stock picks are based on bullish chart patterns, key support levels, and momentum indicators.

Markets.title: Netflix shares slide 4% as slowing sales growth raises fresh concerns
Markets.summary: Netflix shares dropped 4% after the company reported its slowest sales growth in three years and provided a weaker-than-expected fourth-quarter outlook. Lower-than-expected advertising revenue and a 30% decline earlier in the year added to investor concerns.

Geo-Political.title: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war
Geo-Political.summary: Russia stated it is ready to resume negotiations with Ukraine and the United States to end the ongoing war. This announcement followed a meeting in St. Petersburg between Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff.

Geo-Political.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron accused foreign leaders of exploiting recent riots in France. His comments were apparently directed at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, both of whom face upcoming elections.

Geo-Political.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
Geo-Political.summary: An Australian politician lost both legs following an alleged car attack. The 43-year-old suspect, Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and made his first court appearance on Wednesday.

Geo-Political.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
Geo-Political.summary: Elon Musk stated that special committees have been formed to explore a merger between Tesla and SpaceX. This potential combination would merge the electric vehicle and aerospace companies into a single enterprise.

Geo-Political.title: Pakistan arrests man wanted by US over $126m postage fraud case
Geo-Political.summary: Pakistani authorities arrested Faheem Akram, a man wanted by the United States for allegedly selling over 5 million counterfeit postage labels for $2 each. The fraudulent scheme resulted in an estimated $126 million in losses.

Geo-Political.title: Gambia to pay victims of Yahya Jammeh's rule from proceeds of his seized US mansion
Geo-Political.summary: The Gambia received $2.5 million from the sale of a Maryland mansion seized from former ruler Yahya Jammeh. The country will use these proceeds to pay reparations to victims of Jammeh's regime.

AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their SaaS WordPress course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for ads. This experiment highlights the growing shift from traditional SEO to AI-driven visibility (AIO).

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers showed differing views on how to balance controlling inflation while avoiding unnecessary restrictions on economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% with unanimous support from all six monetary policy committee members in October. While four members supported shifting to a calibrated tightening stance, two members preferred maintaining a neutral stance.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven by double-digit increases in iron ore, electricity, coal, refinery products, and cement output. Meanwhile, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced contractions ranging from 1.4% to 11.7%.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, significantly higher than the 3.1% increase recorded in the same month last year. This growth was driven primarily by strong increases in the production of coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore.

Data & Insights.title: IMF urges currency flexibility as RBI steps up rupee defence amid oil price pressures, foreign outflows
Data & Insights.summary: The International Monetary Fund advises central banks to allow exchange rates to adjust to global shocks rather than relying on limited short-term interventions. This advice comes as the Reserve Bank of India increases its defense of the rupee amid rising oil prices and foreign capital outflows.

Data & Insights.title: Govt to overhaul tax refund schemes for exporters, sets up two panels
Data & Insights.summary: The government is overhauling tax refund schemes for exporters and has established two panels to manage the process. This decision follows a late last month recommendation by the expenditure finance committee to achieve better targeting and optimal fund utilization.

India.title: E-Signature Services Not Affected: Government On eMudhra Web Security Certificates Row
India.summary: The Indian government stated that e-signature services remain unaffected following a security certificate issue involving eMudhra. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has formed a special team to investigate the incident.

India.title: CLAT 2027 Reservation Rules Changed For MNLU Mumbai; Apply By October 31
India.summary: Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai has revised its reservation rules for CLAT 2027 admissions. The institution has introduced a one percent quota each for transgender candidates and orphans in its undergraduate and postgraduate law courses.

India.title: Nestle, Zydus Wellness Get Notices Over Claims About Infant Nutrition Products, Complan
India.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has issued notices to Nestle and Zydus Wellness regarding claims made about their infant nutrition products. Specifically, regulators have demanded evidence from Zydus Wellness to support the marketing claim that Complan promotes '2 times faster growth'.

India.title: GRAP-1 Rules Explained: Limited Construction, Strict Rules For Cars In Delhi
India.summary: Delhi has implemented GRAP-1 rules after its Air Quality Index reached the 'poor' category at 244. The Commission for Air Quality Management announced the order on Wednesday to enforce restrictions on construction and vehicles.

India.title: Pollution Curbs Under GRAP-1 Imposed In Delhi, Parking Charges To Be Doubled
India.summary: Delhi has implemented Stage 1 of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP-1) following an Air Quality Index ranging between 201 and 300. As part of these pollution curbs, parking fees across the city are being doubled.

India.title: What Jackie Shroff Told Fan Who Was Shot In Chest In Tiger Shroff Firing
India.summary: Umesh Chauhan is recovering at Mumbai's K.E.M. Hospital after being shot in the chest during an incident involving Tiger Shroff's firing. Actor Jackie Shroff spoke with the injured fan regarding the incident during his hospital treatment.

General.title: Burnham defends Jackdaw decision as Badenoch urges PM to overturn ban on new oil and gas licences
General.summary: Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham defended the upcoming start of gas production at the Jackdaw field despite opposition from environmental campaigners. Meanwhile, Conservative leadership candidate Kemi Badenoch urged the Prime Minister to overturn the ban on new oil and gas licences.

General.title: Google staff resign in backlash over its AI contracts with military
General.summary: Several current and former Google DeepMind employees have resigned in protest over the company's artificial intelligence contracts with the military. These workers raised serious ethical concerns regarding the use of AI technology in battlefield operations.
